PREAMB.AGENCY: DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES
PREAMB.SUBJECT: Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health & Human Development; Notice of Closed Meeting
PREAMB.P: Pursuant to section 10(d) of the Federal Advisory Committee Act, as amended, notice is hereby given of the following meeting.

The meeting will be closed to the public in accordance with the provisions set forth in sections 552b(c)(4) and 552b(c)(6), Title 5 U.S.C., as amended. The grant applications and/or contract proposals and the discussions could disclose confidential trade secrets or commercial property such as patentable material, and personal information concerning individuals associated with the grant applications, the disclosure of which would constitute a clearly unwarranted invasion of personal privacy.
